meeting_transcripts("list", ...)

List your meetings from the local store with id, timestamp, title, and transcript status (ready/downloading/failed).

Arguments: page: number (default 1); limit: number (page size, default 50); query: string (title filter); sort: "newest" (default) or "oldest"; filter: {status: "ready"|"downloading"|"failed", date: {from, to}} where from/to are ISO dates ("YYYY-MM-DD") or epoch ms
Example:   meeting_transcripts("list", {"sort":"oldest", "filter":{"date":{"from":"2026-06-01","to":"2026-06-30"}}})
